name: Asteroids (034986-03)

name: Asteroids Deluxe
drawing: DP-165 drawing package, clock and reset sheet
status: 8 devices from the clock, reset and watchdog sheet. A board map for diagnosis, not a complete bill of materials.

name: Battlezone
status: 97 devices from sheets 02A, 02B and 03A -- clock, MPU, address decode, program memory, RAM, option switches, coin door, vector DAC, and the whole digital vector generator (stack and program counter, address selector, vector RAM and ROM, data shifter, state machine, vector timer). Passives, regulators, crystals and the reset switch are read but are not on the IC grid. A board map for diagnosis, not a complete bill of materials.

name: Battlezone Auxiliary Math Box PCB
drawing: DP-156 sheet 3 Side B, section of 035678-01
status: 36 devices from DP-156 sheet 3 Side B -- the whole sheet: Math Box, Output Latch, Audio Output, Control Panel Inputs and Audio Generator, Power Input, cross-checked against the Figure 1 test-point map on sheet 1 Side B. This is the Auxiliary PCB 035678-01, a different board from the Battlezone game PCB, and the board Red Baron shares. Grid positions are read off the drawing; the board outline and pitch are the standard Atari grid, not a measured dimension. A board map for diagnosis, not a complete bill of materials.

name: Centipede

name: Lunar Lander

status: 6 devices from the power and audio sheet. A board map for diagnosis, not a complete bill of materials.

name: Missile Command
status: 14 devices from the sync sheet (clock, H and V counters, sync generation). A board map for diagnosis, not a complete bill of materials.

name: Pong (Rev E)
status: Component complement complete and verified against Atari assembly drawing A001433 Rev E — all 66 ICs at their board grid positions plus 34 discretes. The +5V and GND rails are wired and verified against each device's datasheet, including the three that break the usual TTL convention (7490/7493 on 5/10, 7483 on 5/12, 555 on 8/1). Signal nets are traced by hand from schematic 002826 Rev E and currently cover the video output chain only — 8 nets: VBLANK, 4V, NET, HVID, VVID, VIDEO and the two intermediate sums. The rest of the sheet is not yet traced, so net highlighting is partial.

name: Red Baron

name: Tempest
